messages:
nia (Billing Ops): Heads-up: two enterprise customers reported receiving two different PDFs with the same invoice_id from this morning's run. One PDF omits usage lines (shows $0) while the other shows full usage. They were charged once. :confused:

nia (Billing Ops): Example (redacted):
```
Invoice: 2025-07-INV-5621
Customer: helios-inc
PDF A:
 - Reserved capacity: $800
 - Usage (tokens): $0  <-- missing
 - Tax: $64
 Total: $864

PDF B:
 - Reserved capacity: $800
 - Usage (tokens): $320
 - Tax: $88
 Total: $1,208
Ledger charge: $1,208
```

oliver (FinOps): invoices-bot any duplicates flagged?
invoices-bot: ALERT: duplicate invoice_id detected: 2025-07-INV-5621 (batch invoice_run_2025_07_31).

tara (Payments): Pausing invoice-email-sender for the July run. We should prevent confusing PDFs from being mailed. Also pausing auto-capture for customers who reported duplicates.
morgan (Support): Customer already opened a ticket. They're worried about underbilling earlier; will tell them charge is correct and we'll resend corrected PDF.

nia (Billing Ops): Quick DB checks: `SELECT invoice_id, count(*) FROM invoice_pdfs WHERE period='2025-07' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING count(*)>1;` -> returns 2 rows including 2025-07-INV-5621. invoice_lines and ledger match the correct amounts.
oliver (FinOps): Hypothesis: renderer feature_flag 'line_collapse_v3' was toggled last deploy and pdf-render retry path can write a second pdf and sometimes skips sections. @deploy-bot what was promoted?
deploy-bot: Deploy event: invoice-renderer v2.7.0 -> prod at 1845672000 by ci/pipeline.

nia (Billing Ops): Renderer log snippet: `WARN render_line(): template_missing for 'usage_detail' when feature_flag=line_collapse_v3=true on retry attempt 2 for invoice 2025-07-INV-5621`. Looks like a retry produced an incomplete PDF record.
tara (Payments): Good catch. Proposed steps: 1) keep email job paused 2) mark affected invoice_pdfs as investigating 3) dedupe invoice_pdfs (keep pdf matching invoice_lines totals) 4) re-render missing/correct PDFs with renderer pinned to v2.6.8 or apply hotfix to make render idempotent 5) resend corrected PDFs with note "Corrected invoice: no change to charged amount".
morgan (Support): I'll draft the outreach and hold on refunds. Please share affected list when ready.
oliver (FinOps): Also add alerting for invoice_pdfs count>1 per invoice_id and a regression test for feature_flag combinations that touch templates. Filing FIN-2025-455.
nia (Billing Ops): FIN-2025-455 created and assigned to eng-render. Will update when dedupe/re-render completes. :white_check_mark:
